verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state one API/SDK covers 130+ file formats across four categories, including PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, and email, with a single unified client call (client.parsing.parse). Community feedback corroborates strong parsing quality on complex layouts, though one commenter notes UI/table-extraction friction. Missing for 10: independent verification across the full non-PDF format set (DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/email) beyond the vendor's own supported-types list, and no hands-on report specifically testing non-PDF formats.
